2115757849070498002.en_summary: @fundstrat says AI is enabling more sophisticated hacks into financial institutions, and one solution is a 'proof of human' check in the loop to stop agent or password infiltration, though not a guarantee. He calls $WLD (@worldnetwork) the only proven proof of human platform and also tags $ORBS. He quotes a post claiming hackers are hitting banks in several countries at once.
2115757849070498002.zh_summary: @fundstrat 表示 AI 讓針對金融機構的駭客攻擊更加複雜，其中一個解決方法是在流程中加入「真人證明」，以防止 AI 代理或密碼入侵，但並不保證有效。他稱 $WLD（@worldnetwork）是唯一經過驗證的真人證明平台，並標註 $ORBS。他引用一則貼文，該貼文稱駭客正同時攻擊多個國家的銀行。

2115768671360721241.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says JPMorgan initiated $PLTR at Overweight with a $262 price target, saying "Palantir is already delivering ROI." He notes U.S. commercial revenue grew 149% versus 35% customer growth with 157% net retention, showing existing customers expanding AI spending. An image is attached.
2115768671360721241.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示摩根大通首次覆蓋 $PLTR，給予增持評級，目標價 262 美元，並稱「Palantir 已經在帶來投資回報」。他指出美國商業收入增長 149%，客戶數量只增長 35%，淨留存率 157%，反映現有客戶正擴大 AI 開支。附上圖片。

ticker_notes.PLTR: 摩根大通目標價 $262（@StockSavvyShay 轉述）

2115770348314718707.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $MSFT launched a 10-part bond offering after Azure grew 48%, with AI capex and leases expected to reach about $170B in 2027. He finds it telling that even the last hyperscaler largely funding AI out of pocket is turning to debt rather than slowing its buildout while demand still exceeds supply. An image is attached.
2115770348314718707.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示 $MSFT 在 Azure 增長 48% 後推出分 10 批的債券發行，預期 2027 年 AI 資本開支及租賃將達約 1,700 億美元。他認為，連最後一家主要靠自有資金投資 AI 的超大規模雲端業者也轉向舉債，而不是放慢建設，說明需求仍然大於供應。附上圖片。
